The question

Economic and financial analysis to support infrastructure investment decisions for Payra Seaport Authority.

Developed institutional and financial governance models with PPP frameworks, cost recovery strategies, and sustainability mechanisms.

Analytical contribution.

  1. 01

    Supported the management team of Payra Port Authority, providing technical advice to assess the economic prospects of Payra Sea Port.

  2. 02

    Facilitated measures to incorporate accurate economic and financial feasibility analysis into the special economic and financial report produced by third-party consultants.

  3. 03

    Project cost-benefit and economic and financial analysis.

  4. 04

    Developed a 15-year model showing income, expenditure, capital expenditure, annual P&L including EBIT, EBITDA and pre-tax profit, annual balance sheet and project IRR.
